import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    def normalize(t):
        if not isinstance(t, str):
            return ""
        return t.replace('\x0b', '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').strip()

    def clean_for_xml(t):
        if not isinstance(t, str):
            return t
        return t.replace('\x0b', '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')

    norm_content = {normalize(k): clean_for_xml(v) for k, v in content.items()}

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    def process_shape(shape):
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            norm_text = normalize(shape.text)
            if norm_text in norm_content:
                shape.text = norm_content[norm_text]
        
        if shape.has_table:
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                for cell in row.cells:
                    norm_text = normalize(cell.text)
                    if norm_text in norm_content:
                        cell.text = norm_content[norm_text]
        
        if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == 6:
            for child in shape.shapes:
                process_shape(child)

    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            process_shape(shape)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3:
        apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE_TYPE

def process_text_frame(text_frame, replacements):
    for paragraph in text_frame.paragraphs:
        for rep in replacements:
            orig = rep["original"]
            corr = rep["corrected"]
            
            if orig in paragraph.text:
                if paragraph.runs:
                    first_run = paragraph.runs[0]
                    font_name = first_run.font.name
                    font_size = first_run.font.size
                    font_bold = first_run.font.bold
                    font_italic = first_run.font.italic
                    font_underline = first_run.font.underline
                    
                    color_rgb = None
                    color_theme = None
                    try:
                        if first_run.font.color.type == 1:
                            color_rgb = getattr(first_run.font.color, "rgb", None)
                        elif first_run.font.color.type == 2:
                            color_theme = getattr(first_run.font.color, "theme_color", None)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
                    paragraph.text = paragraph.text.replace(orig, corr)
                    
                    if paragraph.runs:
                        new_run = paragraph.runs[0]
                        if font_name is not None:
                            new_run.font.name = font_name
                        if font_size is not None:
                            new_run.font.size = font_size
                        if font_bold is not None:
                            new_run.font.bold = font_bold
                        if font_italic is not None:
                            new_run.font.italic = font_italic
                        if font_underline is not None:
                            new_run.font.underline = font_underline
                            
                        try:
                            if color_rgb is not None:
                                new_run.font.color.rgb = color_rgb
                            elif color_theme is not None:
                                new_run.font.color.theme_color = color_theme
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                else:
                    paragraph.text = paragraph.text.replace(orig, corr)

def process_shapes(shapes, replacements):
    for shape in shapes:
        if shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
            process_shapes(shape.shapes, replacements)
        
        if getattr(shape, "has_table", False):
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                for cell in row.cells:
                    if hasattr(cell, "text_frame"):
                        process_text_frame(cell.text_frame, replacements)
                        
        if getattr(shape, "has_text_frame", False):
            process_text_frame(shape.text_frame, replacements)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    replacements = content.get("replacements", [])
    if not replacements:
        return
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for slide in prs.slides:
        process_shapes(slide.shapes, replacements)
            
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Case 5: Change Body Text Font to Arial

Original: Original/CalibriToTimesTestA.pptx
Status: Success

Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
Throughout the presentation, change the font for all body text to Arial.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.shapes import PP_PLACEHOLDER, MSO_SHAPE_TYPE

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
    
    new_font = content.get("font_change", {}).get("new_font", "Arial")
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    def process_shape(shape):
        is_title = False
        if shape.is_placeholder:
            try:
                ph_type = shape.placeholder_format.type
                if ph_type in (PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE, PP_PLACEHOLDER.CENTER_TITLE, PP_PLACEHOLDER.SUBTITLE):
                    is_title = True
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        if is_title:
            return
            
        if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
            for child in shape.shapes:
                process_shape(child)
            return
            
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                try:
                    paragraph.font.name = new_font
                except Exception:
                    pass
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    run.font.name = new_font
                    
        if shape.has_table:
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                for cell in row.cells:
                    for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                        try:
                            paragraph.font.name = new_font
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                        for run in paragraph.runs:
                            run.font.name = new_font

    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            process_shape(shape)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys

from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    def find_shape(shapes, shape_id):
        for shape in shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
                return shape
            if hasattr(shape, "shapes"):
                found = find_shape(shape.shapes, shape_id)
                if found:
                    return found
        return None

    for edit in content:
        slide_number = edit.get("slide_number")
        shape_id = edit.get("shape_id")
        new_text = edit.get("new_text")

        if slide_number is None or shape_id is None or new_text is None:
            continue

        slide_idx = slide_number - 1

            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]

                for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        if "Q2" in run.text:

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE_TYPE

def replace_text_in_shape(shape, original, new_text):
    if shape.has_text_frame:
        for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                if original in run.text:
                    run.text = run.text.replace(original, new_text)
                    
    if shape.has_table:
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        if original in run.text:
                            run.text = run.text.replace(original, new_text)
                            
    if shape.has_chart:
        chart = shape.chart
        if chart.has_title and chart.chart_title.has_text_frame:
            for paragraph in chart.chart_title.text_frame.paragraphs:
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    if original in run.text:
                        run.text = run.text.replace(original, new_text)
                        
    if shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
        for child in shape.shapes:
            replace_text_in_shape(child, original, new_text)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            for replacement in content.get('text_replacements', []):
                replace_text_in_shape(shape, replacement['original'], replacement['new'])

    for update in content.get('style_updates', []):
        slide_idx = update['slide_number'] - 1
        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
            shape_id = update['shape_id']
            
            def find_shape(shapes, s_id):
                for s in shapes:
                    if s.shape_id == s_id:
                        return s
                    if s.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
                        found = find_shape(s.shapes, s_id)
                        if found:
                            return found
                return None
                
            target_shape = find_shape(slide.shapes, shape_id)
            if target_shape and target_shape.has_text_frame:
                updates = update['updates']
                for paragraph in target_shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        if 'font_size_pt' in updates:
                            run.font.size = Pt(updates['font_size_pt'])
                        if 'bold' in updates:
                            run.font.bold = updates['bold']
                            
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys

from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for item in content:
        slide_number = item.get("slide_number")
        shape_id = item.get("shape_id")
        summarized_text = item.get("summarized_text")

        if slide_number and 1 <= slide_number <= len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_number - 1]
            for shape in slide.shapes:
                if shape.shape_id == shape_id:

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def normalize_text(text):
    return " ".join(text.split())

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for slide_data in content.get('slides', []):
        slide_idx = slide_data['slide_number'] - 1
        if slide_idx < 0 or slide_idx >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
        
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if not shape.has_text_frame:
                continue
            
            for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                p_text_norm = normalize_text(paragraph.text)
                if not p_text_norm:
                    continue
                    
                for rep in slide_data.get('replacements', []):
                    o_text_norm = normalize_text(rep['original'])
                    if p_text_norm == o_text_norm:
                        new_text = rep['shortened'].replace('\x0b', '\n')
                        if paragraph.runs:
                            paragraph.runs[0].text = new_text
                            for run in paragraph.runs[1:]:
                                run.text = ""
                        else:
                            paragraph.text = new_text
                        break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_italic_to_shape(shape):
    if shape.has_text_frame:
        for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                run.font.italic = True
    
    if shape.has_table:
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                if hasattr(cell, "text_frame") and cell.text_frame:
                    for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                        for run in paragraph.runs:
                            run.font.italic = True
                            
    if hasattr(shape, "shapes"):
        for child_shape in shape.shapes:
            apply_italic_to_shape(child_shape)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    apply_to_slides = content.get("format_text", {}).get("apply_to_slides", [])
    
    for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
        slide_number = i + 1
        if slide_number in apply_to_slides:
            for shape in slide.shapes:
                apply_italic_to_shape(shape)
                
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for edit in content:
        slide_number = edit.get('slide_number')
        if not slide_number or slide_number < 1 or slide_number > len(prs.slides):
            continue
        
        slide = prs.slides[slide_number - 1]
        shape_id = edit.get('shape_id')
        
        target_shape = None
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
                target_shape = shape
                break
        
        if not target_shape or not target_shape.has_text_frame:
            continue

        text_frame = target_shape.text_frame

        if 'paragraph_indices' in edit:
            for p_idx in edit['paragraph_indices']:
                if p_idx < len(text_frame.paragraphs):
                    paragraph = text_frame.paragraphs[p_idx]
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        run.font.italic = True

        if 'specific_runs' in edit:
            for sr in edit['specific_runs']:
                p_idx = sr.get('paragraph_index')
                if p_idx is not None and p_idx < len(text_frame.paragraphs):
                    paragraph = text_frame.paragraphs[p_idx]
                    run_indices = sr.get('run_indices', [])
                    for r_idx in run_indices:
                        if r_idx < len(paragraph.runs):

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for edit in content:
        slide_idx = edit["slide_number"] - 1
        shape_id = edit["shape_id"]
        make_bold = edit["bold"]

        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
            for shape in slide.shapes:
                if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
                    if shape.has_text_frame:
                        for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                            for run in paragraph.runs:
                                run.font.bold = make_bold
                    break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for edit in content:
        slide_number = edit.get("slide_number")
        shape_id = edit.get("shape_id")
        format_changes = edit.get("format", {})

        if not format_changes.get("bold"):
            continue

        if slide_number is not None and 1 <= slide_number <= len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_number - 1]
            
            for shape in slide.shapes:
                if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
                    if shape.has_text_frame:
                        for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                            for run in paragraph.runs:
                                run.font.bold = True
                    break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3:
        apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def _replace_runs(paragraph, new_text):
    if not paragraph.runs:
        paragraph.text = new_text
        return
    paragraph.runs[0].text = new_text
    for i in range(1, len(paragraph.runs)):
        paragraph.runs[i].text = ""

def replace_in_text_frame(text_frame, content):
    full_text = text_frame.text.strip()
    if not full_text:
        return
        
    for k, v in content.items():
        if full_text == k.strip():
            lines = v.split('\n')
            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                if i < len(text_frame.paragraphs):
                    _replace_runs(text_frame.paragraphs[i], line)
                else:
                    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
                    p.text = line
            for i in range(len(text_frame.paragraphs)-1, len(lines)-1, -1):
                p = text_frame.paragraphs[i]
                p._p.getparent().remove(p._p)
            return

    for p in text_frame.paragraphs:
        p_text = p.text.strip()
        if not p_text:
            continue
        
        matched = False
        for k, v in content.items():
            if p_text == k.strip():
                _replace_runs(p, v)
                matched = True
                break
        
        if not matched:
            original_text = p.text
            new_text = original_text
            for k, v in content.items():
                if k in new_text:
                    new_text = new_text.replace(k, v)
            if new_text != original_text:
                _replace_runs(p, new_text)

def process_shape(shape, content):
    if shape.has_text_frame:
        replace_in_text_frame(shape.text_frame, content)
    if shape.has_table:
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                if cell.text_frame:
                    replace_in_text_frame(cell.text_frame, content)
    if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == 6:
        for sub_shape in shape.shapes:
            process_shape(sub_shape, content)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            process_shape(shape, content)
            
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):

        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for item in content:
        slide_num = item.get("slide_number")
        shape_id = item.get("shape_id")
        new_text = item.get("new_text")

        if not slide_num or not shape_id or new_text is None:

import sys
import json
import pptx
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = pptx.Presentation(pptx_path)

    for item in content:
        slide_number = item.get("slide_number")
        shape_id = item.get("shape_id")
        action = item.get("action")

        if slide_number is None or shape_id is None or action != "center_align_text":
            continue

        slide_index = slide_number - 1
        if slide_index < 0 or slide_index >= len(prs.slides):
            continue

        slide = prs.slides[slide_index]

        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
                if shape.has_text_frame:
                    for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                        paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
                break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content_data = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for action_obj in content_data:
        if action_obj.get("action") == "add_slide":
            layout_name = action_obj.get("layout", "Title Only")
            content = action_obj.get("content", {})
            
            selected_layout = None
            for layout in prs.slide_layouts:
                if layout_name.lower() in layout.name.lower():
                    selected_layout = layout
                    break
            
            if not selected_layout:
                for layout in prs.slide_layouts:
                    if "title" in layout.name.lower():
                        selected_layout = layout
                        break
            
            if not selected_layout:
                selected_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]

            slide = prs.slides.add_slide(selected_layout)
            
            if "title" in content and slide.shapes.title:
                slide.shapes.title.text = content["title"]

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Case 28: Fix Slide Order and Agenda

Original: Original/FixAgendaAndOrder_TestA.pptx
Status: Success
Processing Time: N/A s
LLM Engine Used: gemini-3.1-pro-preview
Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
The agenda on slide 2 is all mixed up and the slides are in the wrong order. Please fix the presentation so it flows logically and the agenda list matches the new slide order.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    agenda_update = content.get("agenda_update", {})
    if agenda_update:
        slide_id = agenda_update.get("slide_id")
        shape_id = agenda_update.get("shape_id")
        new_text = agenda_update.get("new_text")
        
        target_slide = None
        for slide in prs.slides:
            if slide.slide_id == slide_id:
                target_slide = slide
                break
                
        if target_slide:
            for shape in target_slide.shapes:
                if shape.shape_id == shape_id and shape.has_text_frame:
                    lines = new_text.split('\n')
                    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                        if i < len(shape.text_frame.paragraphs):
                            shape.text_frame.paragraphs[i].text = line
                        else:
                            p = shape.text_frame.add_paragraph()
                            p.text = line
                    
                    for i in range(len(shape.text_frame.paragraphs) - 1, len(lines) - 1, -1):
                        p = shape.text_frame.paragraphs[i]
                        p._p.getparent().remove(p._p)
    
    slides_reorder = content.get("slides_reorder", [])
    if slides_reorder:
        sldIdLst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
        children = list(sldIdLst)
        elem_map = {int(child.get('id')): child for child in children}
        
        for child in children:
            sldIdLst.remove(child)
            
        for sid in slides_reorder:
            if sid in elem_map:
                sldIdLst.append(elem_map[sid])
                
        for child in children:
            sid = int(child.get('id'))
            if sid not in slides_reorder:
                sldIdLst.append(child)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Please adjust the presentation theme so that charts replace the dark blue/purple with a light blue color, but leave other colors-intact.

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from lxml import etree

def is_dark_blue_purple(hex_str):
    if not hex_str or len(hex_str) != 6:
        return False
    try:
        r = int(hex_str[0:2], 16)
        g = int(hex_str[2:4], 16)
        b = int(hex_str[4:6], 16)
        
        if (r + g + b) > 350:
            return False
            
        if b > g + 10 and b > 40:
            return True
            
        return False
    except ValueError:
        return False

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    new_color = "ADD8E6"
    for rep in content.get('color_replacements', []):
        if rep.get('element') == 'chart' and 'new_color_hex' in rep:
            new_color = rep['new_color_hex'].replace('#', '').upper()
            break
            
    theme_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.theme+xml'
    chart_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.drawingml.chart+xml'
    
    for part in prs.part.package.parts:
        if part.content_type in [theme_type, chart_type]:
            try:
                root = etree.fromstring(part.blob)
                changed = False
                
                for clr in root.xpath('//*[local-name()="srgbClr"]'):
                    val = clr.get('val')
                    if val and is_dark_blue_purple(val):
                        clr.set('val', new_color)
                        changed = True
                        
                for clr in root.xpath('//*[local-name()="sysClr"]'):
                    val = clr.get('lastClr')
                    if val and is_dark_blue_purple(val):
                        clr.set('lastClr', new_color)
                        changed = True
                        
                if changed:
                    part.blob = etree.tostring(root)
            except Exception:
                pass
                
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys
import json
import pptx

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = pptx.Presentation(pptx_path)

    speaker_notes_updates = content.get("speaker_notes_updates", [])
    for update in speaker_notes_updates:
        slide_idx = update["slide_number"] - 1
        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
            notes_slide = slide.notes_slide
            text_frame = notes_slide.notes_text_frame
            text_frame.text = update["notes"]

    delete_slides = sorted(content.get("delete_slides", []), reverse=True)
    for slide_number in delete_slides:
        slide_idx = slide_number - 1
        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide_id_lst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
            slide_id = slide_id_lst[slide_idx]
            prs.part.drop_rel(slide_id.rId)
            slide_id_lst.remove(slide_id)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)

Apply a 'Fade' transition to all slides in the presentation.

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.oxml import OxmlElement
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    transitions_map = {item["slide_number"]: item["transition"] for item in content}

    for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
        slide_number = i + 1
        if slide_number in transitions_map:
            trans_type = transitions_map[slide_number]
            if trans_type.lower() == "fade":
                sld = slide._element
                
                trans_element = sld.find(qn('p:transition'))
                if trans_element is not None:
                    for child in list(trans_element):
                        trans_element.remove(child)
                else:
                    trans_element = OxmlElement('p:transition')
                    timing = sld.find(qn('p:timing'))
                    extLst = sld.find(qn('p:extLst'))
                    if timing is not None:
                        timing.addprevious(trans_element)
                    elif extLst is not None:
                        extLst.addprevious(trans_element)
                    else:
                        sld.append(trans_element)
                
                fade = OxmlElement('p:fade')
                trans_element.append(fade)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.dml import MSO_FILL, MSO_COLOR_TYPE
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE_TYPE
from pptx.shared import RGBColor

def detect_is_light(prs):
    for slide in prs.slides:
        try:
            if slide.background.fill.type == MSO_FILL.SOLID:
                c = slide.background.fill.fore_color
                if getattr(c, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                    r, g, b = c.rgb
                    return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) > 127
        except:
            pass
        
    for master in prs.slide_masters:
        try:
            if master.background.fill.type == MSO_FILL.SOLID:
                c = master.background.fill.fore_color
                if getattr(c, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                    r, g, b = c.rgb
                    return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) > 127
        except:
            pass
    
    return True

def process_shape(shape, default_new_text):
    if shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
        for s in shape.shapes:
            process_shape(s, default_new_text)
        return
    
    try:
        if shape.fill.type == MSO_FILL.SOLID:
            color = shape.fill.fore_color
            if getattr(color, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                r, g, b = color.rgb
                color.rgb = RGBColor(255 - r, 255 - g, 255 - b)
    except:
        pass
        
    if shape.has_text_frame:
        for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                try:
                    color = run.font.color
                    if color and getattr(color, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                        r, g, b = color.rgb
                        color.rgb = RGBColor(255 - r, 255 - g, 255 - b)
                    else:
                        color.rgb = default_new_text
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        run.font.color.rgb = default_new_text
                    except:
                        pass

    if shape.has_table:
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                try:
                    if cell.fill.type == MSO_FILL.SOLID:
                        color = cell.fill.fore_color
                        if getattr(color, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                            r, g, b = color.rgb
                            color.rgb = RGBColor(255 - r, 255 - g, 255 - b)
                except:
                    pass
                for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for run in paragraph.runs:
                        try:
                            color = run.font.color
                            if color and getattr(color, 'type', None) == MSO_COLOR_TYPE.RGB:
                                r, g, b = color.rgb
                                color.rgb = RGBColor(255 - r, 255 - g, 255 - b)
                            else:
                                color.rgb = default_new_text
                        except Exception:
                            try:
                                run.font.color.rgb = default_new_text
                            except:
                                pass

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    is_light = detect_is_light(prs)
    if is_light:
        default_new_bg = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
        default_new_text = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
    else:
        default_new_bg = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        default_new_text = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
        
    for master in prs.slide_masters:
        try:
            if master.background.fill.type != MSO_FILL.PICTURE:
                master.background.fill.solid()
                master.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = default_new_bg
        except:
            master.background.fill.solid()
            master.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = default_new_bg
            
    for slide in prs.slides:
        try:
            if slide.background.fill.type != MSO_FILL.PICTURE:
                slide.background.fill.solid()
                slide.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = default_new_bg
        except:
            slide.background.fill.solid()
            slide.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = default_new_bg
            
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            process_shape(shape, default_new_text)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

            break

    if body_shape and body_shape.has_text_frame:

            p.level = 0

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def insert_slide(prs, layout, index):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    sldIdLst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
    slide_id = sldIdLst[-1]
    sldIdLst.remove(slide_id)
    sldIdLst.insert(index, slide_id)
    return slide

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    # Attempt to find a 'Section Header' layout
    section_layout = None
    for layout in prs.slide_layouts:
        if "section" in layout.name.lower():
            section_layout = layout
            break
    
    # Fallback to commonly used layouts for sections
    if not section_layout:
        try:
            section_layout = prs.slide_layouts[2]
        except IndexError:
            section_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]

    # Map the section headers to the specific slide indices where the corresponding content begins.
    # Index 2: Before 'Motivation'
    # Index 4: Before 'Impact strategy' 
    # Index 7: Before 'Lessons learnt & achievements'
    if len(content) == 3 and len(prs.slides) >= 8:
        indices = [2, 4, 7]
    else:
        # Fallback if structure changes, just place them after the agenda
        indices = [2] * len(content)

    # Insert slides in reverse order so the insertion indices remain accurate
    for i in range(len(content) - 1, -1, -1):
        item = content[i]
        idx = indices[i]
        
        slide = insert_slide(prs, section_layout, idx)
        
        title_shape_id = None
        if slide.shapes.title:
            slide.shapes.title.text = item.get("section_title", "")
            title_shape_id = slide.shapes.title.shape_id
            
        # Try to set the subtitle / secondary placeholder text
        for shape in slide.placeholders:
            if title_shape_id and shape.shape_id == title_shape_id:
                continue
            shape.text = f"Section {item.get('section_number', '')}"
            break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Please add the date to the bottom left corner and the slide number to the bottom right corner of every slide.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from datetime import date
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    today_str = date.today().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    slides_to_modify = set(content.get("slides_to_modify", []))
    additions = content.get("additions", [])

    for idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
        slide_number = idx + 1
        if slide_number in slides_to_modify:
            for addition in additions:
                left = Pt(addition["left"])
                top = Pt(addition["top"])
                width = Pt(addition["width"])
                height = Pt(addition["height"])
                
                textbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
                text_frame = textbox.text_frame
                text_frame.word_wrap = True
                
                p = text_frame.paragraphs[0]
                
                if addition["type"] == "date":
                    p.text = today_str
                    if addition.get("position") == "bottom_left":
                        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
                elif addition["type"] == "slide_number":
                    p.text = str(slide_number)
                    if addition.get("position") == "bottom_right":
                        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.RIGHT

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def replace_in_text_frame(text_frame, old_text, new_text):
    for paragraph in text_frame.paragraphs:
        if old_text in paragraph.text:
            count_in_p = paragraph.text.count(old_text)
            count_in_runs = sum(run.text.count(old_text) for run in paragraph.runs)
            
            if count_in_p == count_in_runs and count_in_p > 0:
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    if old_text in run.text:
                        run.text = run.text.replace(old_text, new_text)
            else:
                p_text = paragraph.text.replace(old_text, new_text)
                if paragraph.runs:
                    paragraph.runs[0].text = p_text
                    for i in range(1, len(paragraph.runs)):
                        paragraph.runs[i].text = ""

def find_shape_by_id(shapes, shape_id):
    for shape in shapes:
        if shape.shape_id == shape_id:
            return shape
        if hasattr(shape, "shapes"):
            found = find_shape_by_id(shape.shapes, shape_id)
            if found:
                return found
    return None

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for edit in content:
        slide_idx = edit["slide_number"] - 1
        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
            shape = find_shape_by_id(slide.shapes, edit["shape_id"])
            
            if shape:
                if hasattr(shape, "has_text_frame") and shape.has_text_frame:
                    replace_in_text_frame(shape.text_frame, edit["original_text"], edit["new_text"])
                elif hasattr(shape, "has_table") and shape.has_table:
                    for row in shape.table.rows:
                        for cell in row.cells:
                            if hasattr(cell, "text_frame") and cell.text_frame:
                                replace_in_text_frame(cell.text_frame, edit["original_text"], edit["new_text"])

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
import pptx

def apply_edits_to_shape(shape, edits):
    if hasattr(shape, "text_frame") and shape.text_frame:
        for p in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for edit in edits:
                orig = edit.get('original', '')
                repl = edit.get('replaced', '')
                if orig and orig in p.text:
                    replaced_in_run = False
                    for run in p.runs:
                        if orig in run.text:
                            run.text = run.text.replace(orig, repl)
                            replaced_in_run = True
                    
                    if not replaced_in_run:
                        p.text = p.text.replace(orig, repl)

    if hasattr(shape, "table") and shape.table:
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                apply_edits_to_shape(cell, edits)

    if hasattr(shape, "shapes") and shape.shapes:
        for child_shape in shape.shapes:
            apply_edits_to_shape(child_shape, edits)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        edits = json.load(f)

    prs = pptx.Presentation(pptx_path)

    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            apply_edits_to_shape(shape, edits)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def replace_text_in_text_frame(text_frame, replacements):
    for paragraph in text_frame.paragraphs:
        p_text = paragraph.text
        if not any(rep['original'] in p_text for rep in replacements):
            continue
            
        # Try to replace within single runs first to preserve local formatting
        for rep in replacements:
            orig = rep['original']
            repl = rep['replacement']
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                if orig in run.text:
                    run.text = run.text.replace(orig, repl)
                    
        # Check if any target string still remains (meaning it spans across multiple runs)
        current_p_text = "".join(r.text for r in paragraph.runs)
        needs_full_replace = any(rep['original'] in current_p_text for rep in replacements)
        
        if needs_full_replace:
            # Replace in the combined text
            for rep in replacements:
                current_p_text = current_p_text.replace(rep['original'], rep['replacement'])
            
            # Put the replaced text into the first run and clear the rest
            if len(paragraph.runs) > 0:
                paragraph.runs[0].text = current_p_text
                for i in range(1, len(paragraph.runs)):
                    paragraph.runs[i].text = ""

def process_shapes(shapes, replacements):
    for shape in shapes:
        if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == 6:  # MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP
            process_shapes(shape.shapes, replacements)
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            replace_text_in_text_frame(shape.text_frame, replacements)
        if shape.has_table:
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                for cell in row.cells:
                    if cell.text_frame:
                        replace_text_in_text_frame(cell.text_frame, replacements)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    for item in content:
        slide_idx = item['slide_number'] - 1
        if 0 <= slide_idx < len(prs.slides):
            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
            process_shapes(slide.shapes, item['replacements'])
            
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    pptx_filepath = sys.argv[1]
    content_filepath = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_filepath, content_filepath)

import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for item in content:
        slide_idx = item["slide_number"] - 1
        if slide_idx < 0 or slide_idx >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
        
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == item["shape_id"]:
                if item["action"] == "update_text":
                    if shape.has_text_frame:
                        if shape.text_frame.paragraphs and shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].runs:
                            shape.text_frame.paragraphs[0].runs[0].text = item["new_text"]
                            for i, p in enumerate(shape.text_frame.paragraphs):
                                for j, r in enumerate(p.runs):
                                    if i == 0 and j == 0:
                                        continue
                                    r.text = ""
                        else:
                            shape.text = item["new_text"]
                break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":

        sys.exit(1)

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    watermark_data = content.get('watermark', {})
    watermark_text = watermark_data.get('text', 'DRAFT')
    apply_to_all = watermark_data.get('apply_to_all_slides', True)
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    slide_width = prs.slide_width
    slide_height = prs.slide_height
    
    width = Inches(8)
    height = Inches(2)
    left = int((slide_width - width) / 2)
    top = int((slide_height - height) / 2)
    
    slides_to_process = prs.slides if apply_to_all else []
    
    for slide in slides_to_process:
        txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
        txBox.rotation = -45.0
        
        text_frame = txBox.text_frame
        text_frame.clear()
        
        p = text_frame.paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = watermark_text
        run.font.size = Pt(120)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(200, 200, 200)
        
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Original: Original/ConditionalTableFormatting_Negatives_TestA.pptx
Status: Success

Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
In all tables throughout the presentation, find any negative numbers and format them to be red and bold.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.shared import RGBColor

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        edits = json.load(f)
        
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for edit in edits:
        slide_idx = edit["slide_number"] - 1
        if slide_idx < 0 or slide_idx >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
        shape_name = edit["shape_name"]
        row_idx = edit["row"]
        col_idx = edit["col"]
        target_text = edit["target_text"]
        bold = edit.get("bold", False)
        color = edit.get("color")
        
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.name == shape_name and shape.has_table:
                try:
                    cell = shape.table.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
                except IndexError:
                    continue
                
                for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    if target_text in paragraph.text:
                        full_text = paragraph.text
                        parts = full_text.split(target_text)
                        
                        paragraph.clear()
                        
                        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                            if part:
                                run = paragraph.add_run()
                                run.text = part
                            
                            if i < len(parts) - 1:
                                run = paragraph.add_run()
                                run.text = target_text
                                if bold:
                                    run.font.bold = True
                                if color == "red":
                                    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 0, 0)
                break

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3:
        apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Overhaul this presentation on the solar system to follow modern educational design principles. Summarize the content on the 'Inner Planets' slide into four key bullet points. For the other content-heavy slides (Overview, Outer Planets, Conclusion), move the detailed paragraphs into the slide notes, leaving only the titles on the slides. Create a new slide titled 'Planetary Sizes' using an appropriate image. Unify the entire presentation with a clean, professional look using an Arial font for titles and a consistent blue and white color scheme.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    blue_color = RGBColor(0, 51, 153)
    white_color = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
    black_color = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
    
    for mod in content.get("slide_modifications", []):
        slide_idx = mod.get("slide_number", 0) - 1
        if slide_idx < 0 or slide_idx >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
        target_shape = None
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == mod.get("target_shape_id"):
                target_shape = shape
                break
                
        if not target_shape:
            continue
            
        action = mod.get("action")
        if action == "move_text_to_notes":
            notes_slide = slide.notes_slide
            notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = mod.get("notes_content", "")
            if target_shape.has_text_frame:
                target_shape.text = ""
                
        elif action == "summarize_text":
            if target_shape.has_text_frame:
                target_shape.text = ""
                tf = target_shape.text_frame
                bullets = mod.get("new_bullet_points", [])
                for i, bullet in enumerate(bullets):
                    if i == 0:
                        p = tf.paragraphs[0]
                    else:
                        p = tf.add_paragraph()
                    p.text = bullet
                    p.level = 0

    for ns in content.get("new_slides", []):
        layout = prs.slide_layouts[5] if len(prs.slide_layouts) > 5 else prs.slide_layouts[1]
        new_slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
        
        if new_slide.shapes.title:
            new_slide.shapes.title.text = ns.get("title", "")
            
        left = Inches(1)
        top = Inches(2)
        width = Inches(8)
        height = Inches(4.5)
        
        for el in ns.get("elements", []):
            if el.get("type") == "image":
                shape = new_slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
                shape.text = f"[Image Placeholder: {el.get('description', '')}]"
                shape.fill.solid()
                shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(230, 230, 230)
                shape.line.color.rgb = blue_color

    for slide in prs.slides:
        if hasattr(slide, 'background') and hasattr(slide.background, 'fill'):
            slide.background.fill.solid()
            slide.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = white_color
            
        title_shape = slide.shapes.title if hasattr(slide.shapes, 'title') else None
        
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if not shape.has_text_frame:
                continue
                
            is_title = False
            if shape == title_shape:
                is_title = True
            elif shape.name in ["TextBox 1", "Title 1"] and shape.top < Inches(2):
                is_title = True
                
            for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                for run in paragraph.runs:
                    if is_title:
                        run.font.name = "Arial"
                        run.font.color.rgb = blue_color
                    else:
                        run.font.color.rgb = black_color

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3:
        apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

On every slide, move the chart legend to the bottom and update the slide title to say '(Legend Bottom)'.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_LEGEND_POSITION

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for item in content:
        slide_number = item.get("slide_number")
        title_shape_id = item.get("title_shape_id")
        new_title_text = item.get("new_title_text")
        chart_shape_id = item.get("chart_shape_id")
        
        # slide_number is 1-indexed
        slide = prs.slides[slide_number - 1]
        
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            if shape.shape_id == title_shape_id:
                if shape.has_text_frame:
                    shape.text = new_title_text
                    
            if shape.shape_id == chart_shape_id:
                if shape.has_chart:
                    chart = shape.chart
                    chart.has_legend = True
                    chart.legend.position = XL_LEGEND_POSITION.BOTTOM

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    pptx_file = sys.argv[1]
    json_file = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_file, json_file)

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    if isinstance(content, dict):
        content = [content]
        
    for item in content:
        if item.get("action") == "add_image":
            image_path = item.get("image_placeholder")
            target_slides = item.get("target_slides", [])
            coords = item.get("suggested_coordinates", {})
            
            left = Pt(coords.get("left", 0))
            top = Pt(coords.get("top", 0))
            width = Pt(coords.get("width", 50))
            height = Pt(coords.get("height", 50))
            
            for slide_num in target_slides:
                if 1 <= slide_num <= len(prs.slides):
                    slide = prs.slides[slide_num - 1]
                    slide.shapes.add_picture(image_path, left, top, width, height)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

On every slide, add a thin, dark gray border around the content.

import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    props = content.get("border_properties", {})
    left = Pt(props.get("left", 15.0))
    top = Pt(props.get("top", 15.0))
    width = Pt(props.get("width", 565.0))
    height = Pt(props.get("height", 812.0))
    line_color = props.get("line_color_rgb", "333333")
    line_width = Pt(props.get("line_width", 1.5))
    
    for slide in prs.slides:
        shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
        
        # Make the rectangle fill transparent
        shape.fill.background()
        
        # Apply border styles
        shape.line.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(line_color)
        shape.line.width = line_width
        
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    pptx_file = sys.argv[1]
    json_file = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_file, json_file)

Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content_data = json.load(f)
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    if "insert_slide" in content_data:
        slide_info = content_data["insert_slide"]
        
        layout_name = slide_info.get("layout", "Title and Content")
        slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
        for sl in prs.slide_layouts:
            if sl.name == layout_name:
                slide_layout = sl
                break
                
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
        
        if slide.shapes.title:
            slide.shapes.title.text = slide_info.get("title", "")
            
        body_shape = None
        for shape in slide.placeholders:
            if shape.placeholder_format.idx == 1:
                body_shape = shape
                break
                
        if not body_shape:
            for shape in slide.placeholders:
                if shape.has_text_frame and shape.placeholder_format.idx != 0:
                    body_shape = shape
                    break
                    
        if body_shape:
            tf = body_shape.text_frame
            for i, item in enumerate(slide_info.get("content", [])):
                if i == 0:
                    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
                else:
                    p = tf.add_paragraph()
                p.text = item
                p.level = 0
                p.font.size = Pt(14)
                
        position = slide_info.get("position", len(prs.slides))
        insert_pos = position - 1
        
        sldIdLst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
        target = sldIdLst[-1]
        sldIdLst.remove(target)
        sldIdLst.insert(insert_pos, target)
        
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    for update in content.get("progress_bar_updates", []):
        slide_idx = update["slide_number"] - 1

            slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]

            if update.get("line_color"):
                shape.line.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(update["line_color"])

    content_path = sys.argv[2]

Prompt:
Translate the entire presentation from Arabic to English. Adjust the layout and text alignment to be appropriate for a left-to-right language.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE_TYPE

def adjust_paragraph_ltr(paragraph):
    if paragraph.alignment == PP_ALIGN.RIGHT:
        paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
    elif paragraph.alignment is None:
        paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
        
    pPr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    if pPr.get('rtl') == '1':
        pPr.set('rtl', '0')

def adjust_text_frame_ltr(text_frame):
    if text_frame is None:
        return
    bodyPr = text_frame._bodyPr
    if bodyPr is not None and bodyPr.get('rtlCol') == '1':
        bodyPr.set('rtlCol', '0')

def process_shape(shape, translations, stripped_translations):
    if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.GROUP:
        for s in shape.shapes:
            process_shape(s, translations, stripped_translations)
            
    if getattr(shape, "has_text_frame", False):
        original_text = shape.text
        norm_text = original_text.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip()
        trans_text = translations.get(original_text)
        if trans_text is None:
            trans_text = stripped_translations.get(norm_text)
            
        if trans_text is not None:
            trans_text = trans_text.replace('\r\n', '\n')
            translated_paragraphs = trans_text.split('\n')
            
            if len(translated_paragraphs) == len(shape.text_frame.paragraphs):
                for p, trans_p_text in zip(shape.text_frame.paragraphs, translated_paragraphs):
                    runs = list(p.runs)
                    if len(runs) == 0:
                        if trans_p_text:
                            p.text = trans_p_text
                    else:
                        runs[0].text = trans_p_text
                        for r in runs[1:]:
                            p._p.remove(r._r)
            else:
                shape.text = trans_text
                
        adjust_text_frame_ltr(shape.text_frame)
        for p in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
            adjust_paragraph_ltr(p)
            
    if getattr(shape, "has_table", False):
        for row in shape.table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                original_text = cell.text
                norm_text = original_text.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip()
                trans_text = translations.get(original_text)
                if trans_text is None:
                    trans_text = stripped_translations.get(norm_text)
                
                if trans_text is not None:
                    trans_text = trans_text.replace('\r\n', '\n')
                    translated_paragraphs = trans_text.split('\n')
                    
                    if len(translated_paragraphs) == len(cell.text_frame.paragraphs):
                        for p, trans_p_text in zip(cell.text_frame.paragraphs, translated_paragraphs):
                            runs = list(p.runs)
                            if len(runs) == 0:
                                if trans_p_text:
                                    p.text = trans_p_text
                            else:
                                runs[0].text = trans_p_text
                                for r in runs[1:]:
                                    p._p.remove(r._r)
                    else:
                        cell.text = trans_text
                
                adjust_text_frame_ltr(cell.text_frame)
                for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    adjust_paragraph_ltr(p)

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    if not content or "translations" not in content[0]:
        return
        
    translations = content[0]["translations"]
    stripped_translations = {k.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip(): v for k, v in translations.items()}
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    for slide in prs.slides:
        for shape in slide.shapes:
            process_shape(shape, translations, stripped_translations)
            
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

  {

      "\u0627\u0644\u062a\u062f\u0631\u064a\u0633 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u0642\u0645\u064a \u0627\u0644\u0646\u0627\u062c\u062d:\n\u0623\u0633\u0626\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0623\u0645\u0644 \u060c \u0627\u0644\u062c\u0632\u0621 \u0627\u0644\u062b\u0627\u0646\u064a": "Successful Digital Teaching:\nReflection Questions, Part Two",
      "\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0639\u0631\u0641\u0629 \u0648\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0647\u0627\u0631\u0627\u062a\n\u0647\u0644 \u062a\u062a\u0636\u0645\u0646 \u0648\u062d\u062f\u0627\u062a\u0643 \u0623\u0646\u0634\u0637\u0629 \u062a\u062a\u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062a\u0639\u0644\u0651\u0645 \u0623\u0646 \u064a\u0643\u0648\u0646 \u0646\u0634\u0637\u064b\u0627 \u0648\u0645\u0628\u062f\u0639\u064b\u0627 \u0648\u064a\u0641\u0643\u0631 \u0628\u0634\u0643\u0644 \u0646\u0642\u062f\u064a\u061f\n\n\u0647\u0644 \u062a\u0639\u0631\u0641 \u0643\u064a\u0641 \u0633\u064a\u0624\u062f\u064a \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062d\u062a\u0648\u0649 \u0648\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0646\u0634\u0637\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062e\u0627\u0635\u0629 \u0628\u0643 \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u062a\u062d\u0642\u064a\u0642 \u0623\u0647\u062f\u0627\u0641\u0643 \u0627\u0644\u062a\u0639\u0644\u064a\u0645\u064a\u0629\u061f\n\n\u0647\u0644 \u064a\u062a\u0636\u0645\u0646 \u0645\u062d\u062a\u0648\u0627\u0643 \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0644\u0645\u064a \u0648\u062c\u0647\u0629 \u0646\u0638\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0627\u0644\u0628 \u0648\u062a\u0637\u0628\u064a\u0642 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u062f \u0636\u0645\u0646 \u0633\u064a\u0627\u0642\u0627\u062a\u0647\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u062e\u0627\u0635\u0629\u061f": "Knowledge and Skills\nDo your modules include activities that require the learner to be active, creative, and think critically?\n\nDo you know how your content and activities will lead to achieving your educational goals?\n\nDoes your scientific content include the student's perspective and the application of materials within their own contexts?",

Please remove any duplicate slides from this presentation. If you find a duplicate, delete the one that is more out of place.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    slides_to_delete = []
    for item in content:
        if item.get("action") == "delete_slide":
            slide_number = item.get("slide_number")
            if slide_number is not None:
                slides_to_delete.append(slide_number - 1)

    # Sort indices in descending order to avoid shifting issues when deleting
    slides_to_delete.sort(reverse=True)

    for slide_index in slides_to_delete:
        if 0 <= slide_index < len(prs.slides):
            rId = prs.slides._sldIdLst[slide_index].rId
            prs.part.drop_rel(rId)
            del prs.slides._sldIdLst[slide_index]

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)

Case 89: Fill in Animal Research poster

Original: Original/AnimalResearchPoster.pptx
Status: Success
Processing Time: N/A s
LLM Engine Used: gemini-3.1-pro-preview
Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
I have two research posters, one for a toucan and one for a snake, but they are filled with placeholder text. Please research these animals and replace all the 'Lorem Ipsum' text with relevant, factual information. Make sure the information fits the context of each section on the posters and adjust font sizes for readability. Also, update the source citations at the bottom of each poster.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation

def get_shape_by_id(shapes, shape_id):
    for shape in shapes:
        if getattr(shape, "shape_id", getattr(shape, "id", None)) == shape_id:
            return shape
        if getattr(shape, "shape_type", None) == 6 or getattr(shape, "is_group", False):
            try:
                found = get_shape_by_id(shape.shapes, shape_id)
                if found:
                    return found
            except Exception:
                pass
    return None

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)
        
    for slide_data in content:
        slide_idx = slide_data.get("slide_number", 1) - 1
        if slide_idx < 0 or slide_idx >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
        edits = slide_data.get("edits", [])
        
        for edit in edits:
            shape_id = edit.get("shape_id")
            new_text = edit.get("text")
            
            shape = get_shape_by_id(slide.shapes, shape_id)
            if shape and shape.has_text_frame:
                original_font_name = None
                original_font_size = None
                original_bold = None
                original_italic = None
                original_color = None
                
                found_format = False
                for p in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs:
                        if r.text.strip():
                            original_font_name = r.font.name
                            original_font_size = r.font.size
                            original_bold = r.font.bold
                            original_italic = r.font.italic
                            try:
                                original_color = r.font.color.rgb
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                            found_format = True
                            break
                    if found_format:
                        break
                        
                shape.text = new_text
                
                for p in shape.text_frame.paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs:
                        if original_font_name is not None:
                            r.font.name = original_font_name
                        if original_font_size is not None:
                            r.font.size = original_font_size
                        if original_bold is not None:
                            r.font.bold = original_bold
                        if original_italic is not None:
                            r.font.italic = original_italic
                        if original_color is not None:
                            try:
                                r.font.color.rgb = original_color
                            except Exception:
                                pass

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
        
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Case 94: Slide Size Conversion 4:3 → 16:9

Original: Original/Size43to169_DifferentContent_TestA.pptx
Status: Success
Processing Time: N/A s
LLM Engine Used: gemini-3.1-pro-preview
Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
Convert this 4:3 presentation to a 16:9 widescreen format. Make sure all the content fits on the slides and that images are not stretched or distorted.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE_TYPE

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    
    if isinstance(config, list):
        config = config[0]
        
    target_width_pt = config['slide_dimensions']['width']
    target_height_pt = config['slide_dimensions']['height']
    maintain_aspect = config.get('maintain_image_aspect_ratio', True)
    
    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)
    
    old_width = prs.slide_width
    old_height = prs.slide_height
    
    if old_width == 0 or old_height == 0:
        return
        
    target_width_emu = int(target_width_pt * 12700)
    target_height_emu = int(target_height_pt * 12700)
    
    scale_x = target_width_emu / old_width
    scale_y = target_height_emu / old_height
    
    prs.slide_width = target_width_emu
    prs.slide_height = target_height_emu
    
    def process_shapes(shapes):
        for shape in shapes:
            if getattr(shape, "left", None) is None or getattr(shape, "top", None) is None \
               or getattr(shape, "width", None) is None or getattr(shape, "height", None) is None:
                continue
                
            old_cx = shape.left + shape.width / 2.0
            old_cy = shape.top + shape.height / 2.0
            
            new_cx = old_cx * scale_x
            new_cy = old_cy * scale_y
            
            is_picture = False
            try:
                if shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE:
                    is_picture = True
            except:
                pass
                
            if is_picture and maintain_aspect:
                scale_uniform = min(scale_x, scale_y)
                new_width = shape.width * scale_uniform
                new_height = shape.height * scale_uniform
            else:
                new_width = shape.width * scale_x
                new_height = shape.height * scale_y
                
            try:
                shape.width = int(new_width)
                shape.height = int(new_height)
                shape.left = int(new_cx - new_width / 2.0)
                shape.top = int(new_cy - new_height / 2.0)
            except:
                pass

    for master in prs.slide_masters:
        process_shapes(master.shapes)
        for layout in master.slide_layouts:
            process_shapes(layout.shapes)

    for slide in prs.slides:
        process_shapes(slide.shapes)
        
    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    apply_edits(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

Original: Original/ReadingOrderComplex_TestA.pptx
Status: Success

Likely Strategy Used: PYTHON_PPTX_EDIT
Prompt:
On slides 2 through 5, correct the reading order for accessibility. Ensure the slide title is read first, followed by the main text content, and then the image. Adjust the layout to match this logical flow.
Generated Python Code:
import sys
import json
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt

def apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path):
    with open(content_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = json.load(f)

    prs = Presentation(pptx_path)

    for slide_data in content:
        slide_number = slide_data.get("slide_number")
        if not slide_number:
            continue
            
        slide_index = slide_number - 1
        if slide_index < 0 or slide_index >= len(prs.slides):
            continue
            
        slide = prs.slides[slide_index]
        shapes_by_id = {shape.shape_id: shape for shape in slide.shapes}

        if "layout_updates" in slide_data:
            for update in slide_data["layout_updates"]:
                shape_id = update.get("shape_id")
                if shape_id in shapes_by_id:
                    shape = shapes_by_id[shape_id]
                    if "left" in update and update["left"] is not None:
                        shape.left = Pt(update["left"])
                    if "top" in update and update["top"] is not None:
                        shape.top = Pt(update["top"])
                    if "width" in update and update["width"] is not None:
                        shape.width = Pt(update["width"])
                    if "height" in update and update["height"] is not None:
                        shape.height = Pt(update["height"])

        if "reading_order" in slide_data:
            for shape_id in slide_data["reading_order"]:
                if shape_id in shapes_by_id:
                    shape = shapes_by_id[shape_id]
                    element = shape.element
                    element.getparent().append(element)

    prs.save(pptx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    pptx_path = sys.argv[1]
    content_path = sys.argv[2]
    apply_edits(pptx_path, content_path)
